recommendations.title: Provide a meta description for search engine result snippets
recommendations.description: The meta description summarizes page content in search engine result pages, improving user click-through rates.

finding.description: No <meta name="description"> tag was found in document <head>

recommendations.evidence: No <meta name="description"> element detected in document <head>
recommendations.potentialImpact: Search engine result snippet presentation and click-through rate (CTR).
recommendations.suggestedFix: Declare a <meta name="description" content="..."> tag (120-160 characters) in the page <head> section.
recommendations.issue: Provide a meta description for search engine result snippets
recommendations.whyItMatters: Search engine result snippet presentation and click-through rate (CTR).
recommendations.expectedValue: A descriptive meta description tag between 120 and 160 characters
recommendations.reason: Search engines use the meta description as the primary snippet preview in search result cards.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Declare a <meta name="description" content="..."> tag (120-160 characters) in the page <head> section.

recommendations.title: Provide a canonical URL link tag
recommendations.description: Canonical link declarations notify search crawlers of preferred page targets, avoiding duplicate index penalties.

finding.description: No <link rel="canonical"> element found in document <head>

recommendations.evidence: No link element with rel="canonical" found in <head>
recommendations.potentialImpact: Consolidates duplicate URL indexing signals and avoids search ranking fragmentation.
recommendations.suggestedFix: Declare <link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/authoritative-path"> in the <head> of every page.
recommendations.issue: Provide a canonical URL link tag
recommendations.whyItMatters: Consolidates duplicate URL indexing signals and avoids search ranking fragmentation.
recommendations.expectedValue: <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing to authoritative canonical URL
recommendations.reason: Canonical link declarations prevent duplicate content indexing penalties across query-parameter variations.
recommendations.suggestedFixSummary: Declare <link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/authoritative-path"> in the <head> of every page.
